podcastWorkshopTool.title: Podcast workshop
podcastWorkshopTool.subtitle: Create an oral production task where students move from ideas and planning to script, recording, and a finished podcast.

video.title: Watch podcast video
video.text: Placeholder for a short walkthrough of how to create a podcast workshop.

assignment.title: Assignment
assignment.description: Set the frame for the podcast students will create.

fields.title: Title
fields.titlePlaceholder: For example: AI in everyday life
fields.subject: Subject
fields.assignmentPlaceholder: Create a podcast where you explain the topic and use your own examples.

criteria.title: Criteria
criteria.description: The criteria follow the student through the work and appear again in the final room.

support.title: Support material
support.description: Add questions and concrete starters students can use while working and reflecting.
support.questionsDescription: The questions can help students think through the content and review their work before submission.
support.sectionWordsTitle: Support words and starters by section
support.sectionWordsDescription: One word or sentence starter per line. These appear when the student clicks Show support words in the matching field.
support.sectionWordsPlaceholder: Write one support word or starter per line...

podcastName.title: Podcast name
podcastName.help: Words that help the student find a clear title.

participants.title: Who should be involved?
participants.help: Roles and phrases for host, guest, interviewer, and participant.

ideas.title: My ideas
ideas.help: Starters for ideas, facts, examples, and things to investigate.

importantPoints.title: What is important to bring out?
importantPoints.help: Starters that help the student choose main points.

listenerTakeaway.title: What should the listener take away?
listenerTakeaway.help: Starters for a final thought, message, or question.

segment.title: Part: {title}
segment.help: Support words for this part of the podcast.

segments.title: Podcast structure
segments.description: Split the podcast into intro, content parts, and ending.
segments.hint: What should the student do here?

settings.title: Work mode and AI
settings.description: Control how freely students work with script, and whether AI is available as a coach.
settings.locked: Beta v1 is individual and private: only the teacher/owner can see the final product when the student flow is connected.

overview.title: Overview
overview.principle: The teacher sets the frame. The student builds the line.
overview.next: Next connection: save to My content, share to Space, student flow with ideas, script, segment recording, and final room.

save.bottomHint: Save when the assignment is ready.

criteria.intro: The podcast has a clear intro
criteria.duration: The podcast stays close to the recommended length
criteria.ending: The podcast has a clear ending

questions.everyday: Where do we meet this in everyday life?
questions.takeaway: What do you want the listener to remember?

intro.title: Intro
intro.hint: Present the topic and bring the listener in.

part2.title: Part 2
part2.hint: Explain the next point or another perspective.

ending.title: Ending
ending.hint: Summarize what the listener should take away.
